name: Experimental Design
intent: Choose an experiment design from the question and unit structure, create a seeded allocation schedule, and document randomization, replication, blocking, and analysis implications before data collection.

inputs.description: A protected study.json containing the research question, assignment and analysis units, response, arms, seed, nuisance factors, enrollment mode, and assignable units.

outputs.description: design/design-plan.json records the selected method and design decisions.
design/allocation.csv records a seeded assignment for every randomization unit.
design/design-report.md records the method, units, response, nuisance handling, replication warning, seed, and schedule path.

preconditions.description: The study contract names at least two arms and at least two unique assignable units.
The assignment level, assignment unit, and analysis unit are explicit before choosing a design.
Python 3.10 or newer with the standard library is available for deterministic lowering.

steps.title: Read the public study contract
steps.description: Read study.json without modifying it and identify the question, response, arms, seed, units, strata, cluster level, and enrollment mode.

steps.title: Identify randomization and replication units
steps.description: Keep the treatment assignment level, independent replicate, and analysis unit aligned, especially for cluster assignments.

steps.title: Select a randomization method
steps.description: Choose cluster randomization for cluster assignment, stratified block randomization when strata exist, permuted blocks for sequential enrollment, and simple randomization otherwise.

steps.title: Generate the allocation schedule
steps.description: Use the declared seed to assign every randomization unit exactly once while respecting the selected blocking or cluster structure.

steps.title: Write the design plan and report
steps.description: Write the public JSON plan, CSV schedule, and Markdown report with the method, units, response, nuisance handling, replication warning, seed, and schedule path.

steps.title: Verify the compiled design
steps.description: Validate all three artifacts against the public study contract and stop if the assignment unit, seed, schedule, or report is inconsistent.

rules.sourceText: The task contract states that study.json is protected and must not be modified.
The replicate must be at the level the treatment is randomized.
rules.normalizedForm: The assignment and independent replication unit must match the treatment-delivery level.

rules.sourceText: Cluster randomization is mandatory when the intervention is delivered at a group level.
rules.normalizedForm: Use cluster-randomized when assignmentLevel is cluster.

rules.sourceText: Balance a prognostic variable across arms by randomizing within each stratum.
rules.normalizedForm: Use stratified-block when individual units declare strata.

rules.sourceText: Permuted blocks keep arms balanced throughout sequential enrollment.
rules.normalizedForm: Use permuted-block for unstratified sequential enrollment.

rules.sourceText: Everything is seeded so the exact schedule can be archived and regenerated.
rules.normalizedForm: Record the seed and generate a reproducible allocation schedule.

rules.sourceText: Blocks, strata, clusters, and nesting must appear in the analysis.
rules.normalizedForm: Document how the design structure must be represented in analysis.

rules.sourceText: The public task contract forbids network access and package installation.
rules.normalizedForm: Do not access the network or install packages during task execution.

tools.name: Python standard library
tools.purpose: Generate and validate deterministic JSON, CSV, and Markdown artifacts without shell composition or third-party packages.

platformNotes.linux: Use the interpreter selected by SKVM_PYTHON or python.
platformNotes.macos: Use the interpreter selected by SKVM_PYTHON or python.
platformNotes.windows: Invoke the interpreter directly; do not depend on POSIX shell syntax.

tools.availabilityCheck: Run the frozen Python >=3.10 standard-library resource probe.

environment.description: Python 3.10 or newer is available; network and package installation are forbidden and no third-party module is required by this artifact slice.

checks.name: Protected study input
checks.assertion: study.json exists, parses, and has the original digest.

checks.name: Design plan contract
checks.assertion: The plan schema and public study fields agree, including the derived method and seed.

checks.name: Assignment and replication safety
checks.assertion: The randomization and replication unit match the treatment-delivery level and cluster assignment uses cluster randomization.

checks.name: Allocation completeness
checks.assertion: Every public unit appears exactly once with a declared arm and the expected stratum.

checks.name: Seed reproducibility
checks.assertion: Regenerating from the public seed and method produces the same ordered schedule.

checks.name: Design report contract
checks.assertion: The report records study id, method, randomization unit, analysis unit, response, seed, nuisance handling, replication note, and allocation path.

recovery.trigger: study.json is missing required public fields or has fewer than two arms or units.
recovery.explanation: Do not invent missing study structure or assignable units.

recovery.trigger: The frozen Python standard-library preflight fails.
recovery.explanation: Treat the missing interpreter as infrastructure and do not install packages.

recovery.trigger: The generated plan, schedule, or report fails a public-contract check.
recovery.explanation: Regenerate once from the same public study and seed, then stop on a second failure.
